revision_basis.rationale: V2 met neural response criteria in every configuration but categorical spike-count action transitions remained confined to disconnected four-member sheets. Use the continuous MBON membrane state already generated by the LIF model as the fixed action variable.

readout.measure: arithmetic mean of bilateral MBON-m1 voltage_after_reset_mv across every 1-ms sample in the configured response window
readout.normalization: divide the bilateral mean voltage by the fixed MBON threshold for that configuration
readout.action_equation: valid cue armed AND continuous_index <= fixed cutoff
readout.direction: lower MBON membrane activity gives equal or greater action drive
readout.no_spike_substitution: spike counts remain secondary neural outcomes and are not used by the action interface

per_configuration_pass_rule.zero_drive: no spikes, interface disarmed, finite state, bounded queues
per_configuration_pass_rule.cue_activation: all eight cues produce at least one spike in every intended KC
per_configuration_pass_rule.starting_activity: factor 1.0 produces at least one bilateral MBON-m1 spike in at least six of eight states
per_configuration_pass_rule.continuous_effect: factor 0.2 reduces continuous MBON readout by at least 30 percent versus factor 1.0 in at least six of eight states
per_configuration_pass_rule.continuous_monotonicity: continuous MBON readout is non-increasing as weights decrease in at least seven of eight states, with no increase exceeding one percent of the full-weight readout
per_configuration_pass_rule.spike_safety: spike counts are non-increasing in at least seven of eight states, with no reversal greater than one spike
per_configuration_pass_rule.action_transition: at one frozen cutoff, action sets are nested as weights decrease; at least three states transition from no action at factor 1.0 to action at a lower factor; factor 0.2 action set contains two through six states

family_pass_rule.axis_coverage: qualifiers span at least two values on every v2 varied axis
family_pass_rule.face_adjacency: configurations differ by one adjacent value on exactly one v2 axis
family_pass_rule.nominal_selection: lower coordinate median target of the largest qualifying component, then nearest qualifying member; ties use lower contact effect, lower pulse, shorter window, lower MBON tau, then lower threshold

outcome_policy.pass: freeze a continuous-readout electrical model and admit a separately frozen local-plasticity gate
outcome_policy.fail: continue to Option 3 rate-based MBON representation with a new policy and preserved result
outcome_policy.inconclusive: repair execution only; do not change this readout, family, or criteria
